scope: API recorded provenance roundtrip and hook late-cancellation/current role/registry/model/cable/local-scope guards. Includes current unaffected cases in these two suites.

cases.name: PathFinder API contract retains validated recorded input provenance after reload without granting completeness
PathFinder API contract accepts a nonempty actual-shaped state with integer cable_id and exact BIGINT revision strings
PathFinder API contract rejects changed project identity, malformed numeric IDs and arbitrary endpoint URLs
PathFinder API contract preserves the exact decimal project gap and rejects missing, nonpositive or oversized values
PathFinder API contract detail readers require exact proposal/project identity and never promote an unaccepted model
PathFinder API contract reads raw diagnostic lookup results with exact points and rejects wrong identity or promoted acceptance
PathFinder API contract uses the server canonical lookup plan and rejects stale selections or malformed capture queries
PathFinder API contract requires an exact settings revision for standalone preview dependency fencing
PathFinder API contract reads a standalone path without cable Apply capability and rejects identity or capability promotion
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration cancels a late planning capture before it can upload
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration refuses changed registry inputs and revoked access before planning artifact upload
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration rejects a changed cable endpoint even when the selection and registry revisions stay equal
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration checks the frozen local endpoint/rule scope after the final server read and before upload
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration does not request admin data or create a frame for a non-admin or mismatched project
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration updates aliases then binds once using the fresh registry revision and active model selection
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration a current-role refusal clears all cached PF data and disposes the protected viewer
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration scope changes synchronously hide the old data and ignore a late previous-login response
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration a bounded extraction failure leaves the live model ready so the admin can reduce scope and retry
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration retains the model after a partial appearance restore, offers Clear retry and clears the error after acknowledgement
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration only explicitly requested retries force a new calculation job
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration captures an independent lookup without a planning artifact and keeps gap resolution in Project Details
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration does not capture or enqueue after a cancelled lookup plan resolves late
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration does not enqueue a late protected capture after Cancel
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration durably cancels an accepted lookup job when Cancel races its creation response
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration keeps lookup discovery refusals safe and distinguishes missing visible geometry from quota errors
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration binds a standalone path to current project inputs even when a caller supplies stale managed fields
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration keeps bounded native routing preferences while reading the current Details gap for cable jobs
PathFinder scope and shared-location orchestration uses the protected controller for selection/transparency and cancels pending viewer work
